snippet.title: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
avs03.com

The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware ambushes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.
